followUps.title: Follow-up tickets
followUps.sub: What finishing this ticket still needs, as agnts sees it. Pick the ones you want, then start them now or keep them held until you start each one.
followUps.modeHint: When on, agnts's runs suggest tickets this one still needs. It makes every prompt a little longer.
followUps.offEmpty: Follow-up suggestions are off for this ticket. Turn them on to have the next run suggest what finishing it still needs.
followUps.onEmpty: Nothing suggested yet. Most tickets need no follow-up.
followUps.waitsForDone: It builds on this ticket's work: you can create it once this ticket is done.
followUps.jiraOff: Connect Jira to file issues there
followUps.create: {count, plural, =0 {Create tickets} one {Create # ticket} other {Create # tickets}}
followUps.createStart: {count, plural, =0 {Create and start} one {Create and start # ticket} other {Create and start # tickets}}
followUps.queuedHint: Started tickets go to the queue now; one that must wait for another starts coding after that one is merged. Held ones wait until you start them.
followUps.dismissedCount: {count, plural, one {# dismissed suggestion} other {# dismissed suggestions}}
followUps.createdNotice: {count, plural, one {# ticket created} other {# tickets created}}, queued until you start them.
followUps.startedNotice: {count, plural, one {# ticket created} other {# tickets created}} and queued to run.
followUps.fromFindingHint: For work outside this change: suggest it as a follow-up ticket instead of sending it back
followUps.settingHelp: Analysis, work and review runs suggest tickets that finishing a ticket still needs: prerequisites, parts to split off, work left undone, gaps a report found. You pick which to create. Off by default because it makes every prompt a little longer; a ticket can turn it on for itself.
followUps.jiraIssueTypeHelp: The type of the Jira issues agnts files when you create a follow-up in Jira. Default: Task.
followUps.planeOff: Connect Plane and link the repository to a Plane project to file work items there
